decisions.reason: The spring-balanced desk lamp has its own page and fits the firm's announced ergonomic, human-centric workplace direction, so management still reads modest results as a temporary ramp-up worth persisting with.

The publicly launched G2 generation of a core interior LED luminaire is central to the portfolio and the firm's sustainable-lighting direction, so dropping it would be hard to justify given the investment and public commitment.

With the sister marine lines A and E already withdrawn, F is the firm's last remaining foothold in the robust marine niche it invested in, so management keeps it, but its low visibility makes a withdrawal considerably more likely than for B and C.
